title: Digital marksheet (real-time)
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.

models.name: EvaluationDocument
models.work: client onSnapshot + client writes allowed by rules

build: /defense/[panelId]: header (panel, venue or virtual link, slot list with StatusBadge), team selector, then the marksheet for the signed-in evaluator.

src/components/defense/DigitalMarksheet.tsx (mobile-first per fypms-ui-design-system): one card per rubric criterion with title, collapsible description, score control (slider + minus/plus stepper, 44px targets, inputMode decimal), clamp to max_points via clampScores, comments textarea, sticky bottom bar with running total and Saved / Syncing state.

Writes go straight from the client with setDoc merge to evaluations/{teamId}__{uid}__team with fields team_id, evaluator_id, evaluator_role (panel_chair for the chair, panel_member otherwise, supervisor for the assigned supervisor), rubric_id, scores, total_score (computed), comments, is_published false, created_at/updated_at. Optimistic local state first, debounced write (about 400 ms), retry with backoff and an error toast.

Chair and coordinator live panel: onSnapshot on evaluations where team_id equals the selected team shows per-examiner subtotals and a live composite computed with compositeScore; chair gets a Conclude button calling conclude-defense-slot. Always return the unsubscribe from useEffect.
Locked: when an evaluation has is_published true all inputs are disabled and a banner explains why.
Supervisor continuous assessment uses the same component for their own team via /defense/[panelId]?team=<id> and a link from /supervision (visible once the team has a slot).
Tests: unit test for the debounce/save hook with fake timers; component test for clamping and the locked state.
assumptions: Supervisors score continuous assessment through the same marksheet component (spec does not define a separate screen)
acceptance: Two browser sessions scoring the same team show each other's subtotals in the chair view within about a second
Listeners are cleaned up on navigation
